title: Liam – An Innovation Story
summary: A short Apple promotional video about Liam, a robot that disassembles old iPhones so their materials can be recovered. It frames the robot as part of Apple's product life cycle and recycling story.
why: Cited in repair and recycling threads as Apple's showcase of its iPhone disassembly robot, and sometimes mocked as marketing for what is really shredding.

quote.text: see the Liam[0] robot that takes an iPhone down to constituent parts
